images.name: studio
images.prompt: Art direction for the independent digital design studio Hareb Digital. High-end physical set photography, photorealistic materials, refined contemporary design editorial. Palette strictly warm ivory, charcoal graphite, brushed silver aluminium and pale electric chartreuse #d4ed8a. Real micro scratches and paper fibres, soft directional daylight, rich blacks, subtle 35mm grain, controlled highlights, elegant and tactile, avoid the glossy generic AI look. No typography, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no people, no screens with fake UI, no neon cyberpunk. THE DESIGNER'S PROCESS. Top-down editorial macro still life on a warm ivory table: overlapping sheets of translucent vellum with faint precise pencil grid lines, a single beautifully folded thin brushed-aluminium ribbon prototype, a chartreuse spool of thread that snakes between the layers. Small physical paper maquettes, material samples, one steel ruler partly cropped. Intentionally art-directed, asymmetrical and spacious, strongly raking afternoon sunlight with long shadows. A material study about thought, craft and precision, not a fake photograph of an actual office. 80mm medium-format lens.

camera.prompt: ONE UNBROKEN FIRST-PERSON CAMERA FLIGHT. Begin exactly inside the aluminium and glass installation of the start frame. The camera physically FLIES FORWARDS THROUGH THE GANGWAYS between the tall rectangular plates, following the chartreuse cables. Camera stays low within the corridors throughout the first half; no crane up, no orbit around the installation, no sideways showcase. 0-3 seconds: confident forward dolly into the narrow aisle; large near plates sweep out of frame left and right, strong real parallax. 3-6 seconds: forward speed increases rapidly, camera follows one subtle S-bend into the next passage and clears successive glass walls, passing close to the cables. Multiple cables extend along the walls and floor. 6-9 seconds: exponential acceleration, every successive corridor rushes past faster, edges pull into long directional motion streaks, the physical cables begin glowing intensely with pale chartreuse electricity, branch into long luminous strands and stream past the lens. 9-12 seconds: reach impossible LIGHT SPEED; the architecture stretches and dissolves organically into the endless dark cosmic electric space of the end frame, the cables become vast silver-white and pale lime cosmic energy currents surrounding the camera. Finish travelling INSIDE this cosmic flow at maximum speed, NOT slowing down or stopping. The original cable paths continuously become the energy filaments; one physical-to-cosmic metamorphosis in the same shot, no crossfade to an unrelated space image. Start material realism: brushed metal, frosted glass, charcoal floor. End: sophisticated photoreal VFX, deep charcoal space, directional particle streaks, silver and chartreuse plasma rivers, subtle ice-blue mist. Keep the flight path centered for mobile cropping. Physically moving camera with new scenery revealed; strong foreground parallax and motion blur. No zoom on a still, no pullback, no overhead view, no cuts, no logos, no lettering, no circular monograms, no spaceship, no cockpit, no strobe or white-out flash. Cinematic 24mm wide-angle perspective; progressively more pronounced velocity blur as speed rises. Silent.

startFrame.prompt: Wide 16:9 architectural photograph for a premium design studio. A physically built abstract landscape, not a letter, not a logo, not a loop: dozens of thin vertical brushed-aluminium fins and translucent glass planes arranged in a precise staggered field on a charcoal floor. One narrow pale chartreuse fibre runs from the bottom centre into the distance, threading BETWEEN the plates. Rectangular flat plates only, no curved bands, no typographic silhouettes, no arches, no circles, no spirals. We are very low at the entrance to the field looking along the fibre, with strong foreground parallax from a large out-of-focus glass edge on far right. Strong single-point perspective; the middle corridor opens toward a soft large ivory light source in the far distance. A tactile miniature architecture that can be explored with a camera. Charcoal, silver, frosted glass, pale lime #d4ed8a only. Finely brushed surfaces and dust detail, subtle film grain, photographic not glossy, 35mm cine lens, beautifully controlled soft side lighting. Sculptural engineering, a digital ecosystem made physical. NO text, no interface, no letters, no logos, no people. Compose a clear path for a camera travelling forwards between the planes.

endFrame.prompt: A photorealistic cinematic VFX still, first-person flight at LIGHT SPEED inside vast cosmic electrical currents in deep space. Absolutely NO architecture, walls or buildings. Dark black-charcoal interstellar void with long thin luminous pale-chartreuse and silver-white electrical filaments. They extend from a small deep vanishing point in the centre of the frame outwards past the camera into all four edges. We are INSIDE the current, not viewing a sphere from outside. Several sweeping cable-shaped plasma rivers pass very close to the lens on both sides, countless finer wires behind them create profound layered depth. Blurred directional light streaks radiate along the direction of travel. Subtle pale ice-blue ionised dust clouds curl between the electric filaments. Extreme forward velocity, long exposure motion blur at the outer edges, crisp far central depth. Refined sophisticated visual effects, cinematic 24mm perspective, tactile energy, deep blacks with thin controlled highlights, pale lime #d4ed8a and silver palette with very faint blue. No rings, no planets, no ball of energy, no wormhole circles, no spaceship, no cockpit, no text, no logos, no letters, no UI, no rainbow colours, no white flash, no opaque object blocking the forward path. Landscape 16:9, central focal point at exact image centre. Award-level cinematic cosmic art, enveloping and immersive.
